description: Agent-readable catalog for @roboborealis/components. Auto-generated by scripts/generate-manifest.ts — do not edit manually. Shipped via the @roboborealis/components/agent-context export; also readable in-repo at src/agent/manifest.json.

componentMeta.description: Static banner for important messages, warnings, or status notifications
componentMeta.whenToUse: For persistent page-level messages — form errors, system status, deprecation warnings
componentMeta.neverUse: Transient notifications — use RoboToast instead
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses role=alert for error/warning (assertive) or role=status for info/success (polite)
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For transient notifications use RoboToast; for inline field errors use RoboFormField
componentMeta.a11y: Uses role="alert" for urgent messages or role="status" for informational; includes aria-live region
componentMeta.animation: animate: boolean — entrance animation (scale-in or slide-in depending on component)

componentMeta.description: Floating menu of actions anchored to a trigger element
componentMeta.whenToUse: For a list of actions triggered from a button or avatar — user menus, row actions, more-options menus
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For arbitrary content (not a list of actions) use RoboPopover; for a full modal use RoboDialog
componentMeta.a11y: Uses Radix DropdownMenu — manages focus, arrow-key navigation, and aria-expanded/role=menu

componentMeta.description: Branded empty state illustration with a starfield-and-telescope theme
componentMeta.whenToUse: For empty states when no data exists yet — first-run experiences or filtered-to-empty views
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For loading states use RoboSkeletonLoading; for errors use RoboAlert
componentMeta.a11y: Include descriptive alt text; pair with actionable guidance text for screen reader users

componentMeta.description: Determinate progress bar showing completion percentage of a task
componentMeta.whenToUse: For showing file upload progress, multi-step wizard completion, or long-running tasks
componentMeta.neverUse: Indeterminate loading — use RoboSpinner
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses role=progressbar with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For indeterminate loading use RoboSpinnerLoading; for content placeholders use RoboSkeletonLoading
componentMeta.a11y: Uses role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax
componentMeta.animation: animateEntrance: boolean — fade-in entrance via RoboFadeIn (preset: standard)

componentMeta.description: Transient notification that appears briefly then auto-dismisses
componentMeta.whenToUse: For transient success/error/info messages that auto-dismiss (save confirmation, action feedback)
componentMeta.neverUse: Persistent messages — use RoboAlert inline instead
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses role=status with aria-live=polite. Auto-dismiss with configurable duration
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For persistent messages use RoboAlert; for blocking confirmations use RoboDialog
componentMeta.a11y: Uses aria-live="polite" for info and aria-live="assertive" for errors; auto-dismiss respects prefers-reduced-motion

componentMeta.description: Thin indeterminate loading bar pinned to the top of the viewport, for background/route-level loading signals
componentMeta.whenToUse: When one or more async operations (data fetches, route transitions) are in flight and you want a passive, non-blocking global loading cue
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For a known completion percentage use RoboProgress; for a scoped/inline loading state use RoboSpinnerLoading or RoboSkeletonLoading
componentMeta.a11y: Uses role="progressbar" with aria-valuetext="Loading" (indeterminate — no aria-valuenow)

componentMeta.description: Binary toggle input for boolean options or multi-select lists
componentMeta.whenToUse: For boolean options (terms acceptance), multi-select lists, or filter toggles
componentMeta.neverUse: Mutually exclusive options — use RoboRadioGroup. Feature toggles — use RoboSwitch
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Always pair with a visible label. Indeterminate state needs aria-checked='mixed'
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For mutually exclusive options use RoboRadioGroup; for on/off settings use RoboSwitch
componentMeta.a11y: Always associate with a label; indeterminate state needs aria-checked="mixed"

componentMeta.description: Calendar-based date selection with range support and locale formatting
componentMeta.whenToUse: For selecting dates, date ranges, or datetime values in forms and filters
componentMeta.neverUse: Time-only input — use a time input. Relative dates — use a select dropdown
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Calendar grid uses arrow keys for navigation. Pair with visible label
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For time-only input use a time picker; for relative time ("last 7 days") use RoboSelect
componentMeta.a11y: Calendar grid uses role="grid" with arrow-key navigation; announce selected date to screen readers

componentMeta.description: Form field wrapper providing label, validation, and helper text for any input
componentMeta.whenToUse: Wrap every form input — provides label association, error display, and helper text
componentMeta.neverUse: Outside of react-hook-form context — the field binds to form state
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Connects label to input via htmlFor. Error uses role=alert
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For standalone labels without validation use RoboLabel; for non-form content use RoboCard
componentMeta.a11y: Automatically associates label with input via htmlFor; error messages use role="alert"

componentMeta.description: Text input field with label, validation, and helper text support
componentMeta.whenToUse: For single-line text entry — names, emails, search queries, numbers
componentMeta.neverUse: Multi-line text — use RoboTextarea. Rich text — use RoboRichTextEditor
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Always pair with a visible label or aria-label
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For multi-line text use RoboTextarea; for selection use RoboSelect; for dates use RoboDatePicker
componentMeta.a11y: Always wrap in RoboFormField for automatic label association; required fields get aria-required

componentMeta.description: Press-keys-to-record control for reassigning a keyboard shortcut, displaying the captured combo via RoboKbd
componentMeta.whenToUse: Settings pages that let users reassign a shortcut registered with RoboKeybindProvider
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: Read-only shortcut display — use RoboKbd directly
componentMeta.a11y: aria-live="polite" announces the listening state via its accessible name; Escape or blur cancels without committing; focus ring visible in both idle and listening states

componentMeta.whenToUse: Mutually exclusive selection from 2-5 visible options
componentMeta.neverUse: Many options — use RoboSelect. Boolean — use RoboCheckbox or RoboSwitch
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses role=radiogroup with arrow key navigation between options

componentMeta.whenToUse: For mutually exclusive choices with 2-5 visible options (payment type, priority level)
componentMeta.neverUse: Many options — use RoboSelect. Boolean — use RoboCheckbox or RoboSwitch
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses role=radiogroup with arrow key navigation between options
componentMeta.description: Mutually exclusive option selector for single-choice form fields
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For many options use RoboSelect; for boolean toggle use RoboCheckbox or RoboSwitch
componentMeta.a11y: Uses role="radiogroup" with arrow-key navigation between options; one must always be selected if required

componentMeta.whenToUse: Multi-line rich text input with formatting (bold, italic, lists, links)
componentMeta.neverUse: Simple text — use RoboTextarea. Code input — use a code editor component
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses Slate.js with ARIA toolbar. Tab moves focus out of editor, Shift+Tab moves back in

componentMeta.whenToUse: For selecting from 5+ options, searchable lists, or grouped selections
componentMeta.neverUse: Free-text input — use RoboInput. Multi-select — use RoboCheckboxGroup or RoboChip with popover
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses Radix Select with keyboard navigation and proper listbox role
componentMeta.description: Dropdown selection control with search, multi-select, and grouping
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For 2-4 visible options use RoboRadioGroup; for boolean use RoboSwitch; for actions use RoboDropdownMenu
componentMeta.a11y: Uses Radix Select — manages aria-expanded, listbox role, and typeahead automatically

componentMeta.whenToUse: Numeric range selection (time ranges, zoom levels, volume, filter thresholds)
componentMeta.neverUse: Precise numeric input — use RoboInput type=number. Binary choices — use RoboSwitch
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses role=slider with aria-valuemin/max/now and keyboard arrows

componentMeta.description: Range input for selecting numeric values within a defined min-max
componentMeta.whenToUse: For selecting numeric values within a range — opacity, zoom level, time offsets
componentMeta.neverUse: Precise numeric input — use RoboInput type=number. Binary choices — use RoboSwitch
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses role=slider with aria-valuemin/max/now and keyboard arrows
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For precise numeric entry use RoboInput with type="number"; for date ranges use RoboDatePicker
componentMeta.a11y: Requires aria-label or aria-labelledby; announces current value on change

componentMeta.whenToUse: On/off toggles for settings, feature flags, real-time mode switches
componentMeta.neverUse: Multi-option selection — use RoboRadioGroup. Form boolean — use RoboCheckbox
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses role=switch with aria-checked. Provide visible label

componentMeta.description: Toggle control for binary on/off settings with immediate effect
componentMeta.whenToUse: For settings that take immediate effect (dark mode, notifications, feature toggles)
componentMeta.neverUse: Multi-option selection — use RoboRadioGroup. Form boolean — use RoboCheckbox
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses role=switch with aria-checked. Provide visible label
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For form submission choices use RoboCheckbox; for multi-option use RoboRadioGroup
componentMeta.a11y: Uses role="switch" with aria-checked; label must describe the on-state

componentMeta.description: Multi-line text input for longer-form content entry
componentMeta.whenToUse: For multi-line text — comments, descriptions, notes, reports, narrative fields
componentMeta.neverUse: Single-line values — use RoboInput. Rich text — use RoboRichTextEditor
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Always pair with a visible label or aria-label
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For single-line text use RoboInput; for rich text with formatting use RoboRichTextEditor
componentMeta.a11y: Always wrap in RoboFormField; set rows/maxLength for appropriate sizing

componentMeta.description: Semantic horizontal or vertical divider with optional label
componentMeta.whenToUse: For separating content sections with an optional label or heading text
componentMeta.neverUse: Spacing only — use margin/padding. Semantic sections — use heading hierarchy
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses role=separator with proper orientation
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For simple border lines use CSS border; for generic separators use RoboSeparator
componentMeta.a11y: Uses role="separator" with aria-orientation; labeled dividers have aria-label

componentMeta.description: CSS Grid layout container with responsive column configuration
componentMeta.whenToUse: For multi-column responsive layouts — card grids, form layouts, dashboard sections
componentMeta.neverUse: Single-column vertical stacking — use RoboStack
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses CSS Grid — no accessibility concerns beyond content order
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For single-direction stacking use RoboStack; for page chrome use RoboPageShell
componentMeta.a11y: Purely presentational — ensure content reading order is logical regardless of visual grid position

componentMeta.description: Full-page layout scaffold with sidebar, topbar, and content area
componentMeta.whenToUse: As the outermost layout wrapper for every page — provides sidebar, topbar, and content area
componentMeta.neverUse: Nested inside other layout components — only one per page
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Landmark regions (nav, main, aside) are built in
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For map-centric pages compose RoboMapbox + RoboFloatingPanel directly (map archetypes have no template); for embedded widgets skip the shell
componentMeta.a11y: Provides proper landmark structure (banner, navigation, main); skip-to-content link included

componentMeta.description: Flexbox layout primitive for vertical or horizontal item stacking
componentMeta.whenToUse: For stacking elements vertically or horizontally with consistent gap spacing
componentMeta.neverUse: Multi-column layouts — use RoboGrid
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses CSS Flexbox — no accessibility concerns beyond content order
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For complex grid layouts use RoboGrid; for full-page structure use RoboPageShell
componentMeta.a11y: Purely presentational — ensure logical DOM order matches visual order

componentMeta.description: Catches render errors in its subtree and shows a full-page RoboErrorState instead of crashing
componentMeta.whenToUse: Wrap a page or app shell content area so an unexpected render error degrades gracefully
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For expected/handled errors (failed form submit, failed fetch) use RoboAlert or RoboErrorState directly, not a boundary
componentMeta.a11y: Delegates to RoboErrorState, which uses role="status" and an accessible retry button

componentMeta.description: Branded animated loading and error indicator with a lost-satellite illustration
componentMeta.whenToUse: For full-page or section-level loading states with branded personality
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For inline spinners use RoboSpinnerLoading; for content placeholders use RoboSkeletonLoading
componentMeta.a11y: Includes aria-label="Loading" and role="status" with aria-live="polite"
componentMeta.animation: animateEntrance: boolean — fade-in entrance via RoboFadeIn (preset: standard)

componentMeta.description: Branded animated loader with an orbiting-satellite motif
componentMeta.whenToUse: For full-page loading states with space branding
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For inline spinners use RoboSpinnerLoading; for fast-loading states use RoboSkeletonLoading
componentMeta.a11y: Includes aria-label="Loading" and role="status" with aria-live="polite"

componentMeta.description: Decorative loading placeholder in text, circle, and rect variants
componentMeta.whenToUse: While content or data is loading to preserve layout and reduce perceived wait
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For button loading states use RoboSpinner; for branded full-page loads use RoboLoading or RoboErrorState
componentMeta.a11y: Always rendered aria-hidden since it is purely decorative; respects prefers-reduced-motion via motion-safe pulse

componentMeta.description: Content placeholder animation mimicking the shape of expected content
componentMeta.whenToUse: For content loading placeholders that match the layout of the expected content
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For page-level loading use RoboErrorState; for inline operations use RoboSpinnerLoading
componentMeta.a11y: Use aria-busy="true" on the parent container; aria-label="Loading content" on skeleton region

componentMeta.description: Inline spinning indicator for in-progress operations
componentMeta.whenToUse: For inline loading states — button submissions, field validation, small async operations
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For full-page loading use RoboErrorState; for content placeholders use RoboSkeletonLoading
componentMeta.a11y: Requires aria-label="Loading" or sr-only text; use role="status" with aria-live="polite"

componentMeta.whenToUse: Mobile navigation bar fixed to the bottom of the viewport
componentMeta.neverUse: Desktop apps — use RoboSidebar. More than 5 items — use a hamburger menu
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses <nav> landmark with aria-label='Main navigation'

componentMeta.description: Mobile bottom navigation bar for primary app sections
componentMeta.whenToUse: For mobile app bottom navigation with 3-5 primary destinations
componentMeta.neverUse: Desktop apps — use RoboSidebar. More than 5 items — use a hamburger menu
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses <nav> landmark with aria-label='Main navigation'
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For desktop navigation use RoboSidebar; for contextual tabs use RoboTabs
componentMeta.a11y: Uses role="navigation" with aria-label; active item indicated with aria-current="page"

componentMeta.whenToUse: Hierarchical page navigation showing the user's location in the app
componentMeta.neverUse: Flat navigation — use RoboTabs. Deep hierarchies (>4 levels) — truncate middle items
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses <nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'> with aria-current on last item

componentMeta.description: Hierarchical navigation path showing the current page location
componentMeta.whenToUse: For showing page hierarchy and enabling navigation back to parent sections
componentMeta.neverUse: Flat navigation — use RoboTabs. Deep hierarchies (>4 levels) — truncate middle items
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses <nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'> with aria-current on last item
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For primary navigation use RoboSidebar; for related pages use links
componentMeta.a11y: Uses nav with aria-label="Breadcrumb"; current page marked with aria-current="page"
componentMeta.animation: animate: boolean — entrance animation (scale-in or slide-in depending on component)

componentMeta.description: Keyboard hint row (key + label pairs) shown in command palette footers
componentMeta.whenToUse: Footer row of a command palette or similar keyboard-driven overlay to remind users of navigation keys
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For a single inline shortcut hint use RoboKbd directly
componentMeta.a11y: Purely decorative — aria-hidden; do not rely on it to convey required information to screen reader users

componentMeta.whenToUse: For power-user quick navigation and action execution via keyboard (Cmd+K pattern)
componentMeta.neverUse: Primary navigation — use RoboSidebar. Search — use RoboInput with search results
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses combobox pattern with aria-activedescendant for list selection
componentMeta.description: Keyboard-activated command search overlay for power users
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For simple search use RoboInput with search icon; for menus use RoboDropdownMenu
componentMeta.a11y: Uses role="dialog" with combobox pattern; manages focus and announces results to screen readers

componentMeta.description: A peek-docked, pinnable, tabbed utility panel that can be summoned from anywhere in the app — shortcuts, recents, notifications, quick settings.
componentMeta.whenToUse: For an always-available, app-wide utility surface a user can peek at, pin open, or summon via keyboard shortcut — not for page-specific content
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For a page-scoped click-triggered overlay use RoboSheet; for map-only glanceable overlays use RoboPeekSheet; for a command/search launcher use RoboCommandPalette
componentMeta.a11y: role="complementary" landmark, not a modal dialog — no focus trap; peek/pin handle is a real <button> with aria-pressed (single click, independent of hover) and a tooltip explaining the double-click-to-pin gesture on the body; supports controlled open/onOpenChange for external keybind toggling with an aria-live announcement on programmatic open/close
componentMeta.animation: transitionVariant?: RoboTransitionVariant — selectable enter/exit animation style (curtain-wipe, pixel-dissolve, iris-clip, venetian-blinds, depth-fade); default reproduces existing behavior unchanged

componentMeta.description: Collapsible vertical navigation panel for primary app structure. Click the toggle button to collapse to an icon-only rail or expand back — a plain click-to-toggle model with no hover-preview or overlay.
componentMeta.whenToUse: For primary desktop app navigation — collapsible sidebar with sections and icons
componentMeta.neverUse: Content sidebars or secondary panels — use RoboFloatingPanel for map contexts
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses <nav> landmark. Keyboard navigable with arrow keys
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For mobile bottom nav use RoboBottomNav; for contextual tabs use RoboTabs
componentMeta.a11y: Uses role="navigation" with aria-label — always exactly one landmark. Collapsed state shows tooltips for icon-only items; the toggle button is a plain, single-click control.
componentMeta.animation: animateItems: boolean — staggered item entrance with CSS animation-delay

componentMeta.whenToUse: Switching between related views without navigation
componentMeta.neverUse: Multi-step wizards — use a stepper pattern. Navigation — use RoboSidebar
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses Radix Tabs with role=tablist, arrow key navigation

componentMeta.description: Horizontal/vertical tab navigation for switching between content panels, with an underline or pill (sliding indicator) visual style
componentMeta.whenToUse: For switching between related content panels within the same page context
componentMeta.neverUse: Multi-step wizards — use a stepper pattern. Navigation — use RoboSidebar
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses Radix Tabs with role=tablist, arrow key navigation
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For page-level navigation use RoboSidebar; for progressive disclosure use RoboAccordion
componentMeta.a11y: Uses role="tablist" + role="tab" + role="tabpanel"; arrow keys move between tabs; the pill variant's sliding indicator is a decorative, aria-hidden sibling that never wraps or replaces Radix's own trigger a11y wiring
componentMeta.animation: animateContent: boolean — RoboFadeIn on tab panel content swap

componentMeta.description: Horizontal header bar with branding, navigation, and user actions
componentMeta.whenToUse: For app header with logo, primary navigation, search, and user menu
componentMeta.neverUse: Page-level headers — use standard heading elements
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses <header> landmark
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For content toolbars within a page use a custom toolbar layout
componentMeta.a11y: Uses role="banner" (or header element); contains primary navigation landmark

componentMeta.whenToUse: Confirmations, destructive action prompts, modal forms
componentMeta.neverUse: Browser confirm() or alert(). Non-blocking info — use RoboToast
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Traps focus, ESC to close, returns focus on dismiss. Uses Radix Dialog

componentMeta.description: Modal overlay for confirmations, forms, or focused tasks requiring user attention
componentMeta.whenToUse: For confirmations, destructive action warnings, focused forms, or detail views
componentMeta.neverUse: Browser confirm() or alert(). Non-blocking info — use RoboToast
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Traps focus, ESC to close, returns focus on dismiss. Uses Radix Dialog
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For non-blocking info use RoboToast; for inline expansion use RoboAccordion; for menus use RoboDropdownMenu
componentMeta.a11y: Traps focus, returns focus on close, uses aria-labelledby on the title element

componentMeta.whenToUse: Interactive content triggered by a button (filters, settings, mini-forms)
componentMeta.neverUse: Static hover info — use RoboTooltip. Large forms — use RoboDialog
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Focus trapped inside popover. ESC to close

componentMeta.description: Floating content panel anchored to a trigger element
componentMeta.whenToUse: For contextual content panels — filter dropdowns, info panels, or mini-forms
componentMeta.neverUse: Static hover info — use RoboTooltip. Large forms — use RoboDialog
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Focus trapped inside popover. ESC to close
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For simple text hints use RoboTooltip; for full modals use RoboDialog; for menus use RoboDropdownMenu
componentMeta.a11y: Uses Radix Popover — manages focus trap, escape-to-close, and aria-expanded

componentMeta.description: Hover/focus-triggered text hint for additional context on UI elements
componentMeta.whenToUse: For supplementary text on icon buttons, truncated text, or abbreviated labels
componentMeta.neverUse: Essential information — use visible text or RoboPopover for interactive content
componentMeta.accessibilityNote: Uses Radix Tooltip with proper aria-describedby linking
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For interactive content use RoboPopover; for important info that must be visible use inline text
componentMeta.a11y: Content is announced via aria-describedby; never put essential information only in tooltips

componentMeta.description: Calendar grid where each day cell is a small bar sized by a daily value
componentMeta.whenToUse: For showing one daily metric across weeks or a year as day-cell bars — like anomaly events per day
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For encoding magnitude by color instead of bar height use RoboCalendarHeatmap; for smooth trends use RoboLineChart
componentMeta.a11y: Renders to a canvas with role img and an aria-label prop that falls back to the title; pair with a data table for screen reader users
componentMeta.animation: animateEntrance: boolean — fade-in entrance via RoboFadeIn (preset: standard)

componentMeta.description: Calendar grid where each day cell is colored by value intensity
componentMeta.whenToUse: For showing daily value intensity over a long period — like daily case count shaded by volume across a year
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For comparing exact daily magnitudes use RoboCalendarBarChart; for variable-vs-variable grids use RoboHeatmap
componentMeta.a11y: Renders to a canvas with role img and an aria-label derived from the title prop; pair with a data table for screen reader users
componentMeta.animation: animateEntrance: boolean — fade-in entrance via RoboFadeIn (preset: standard)

componentMeta.description: Calendar grid where each day cell shows a themed icon chosen or sized by value
componentMeta.whenToUse: For marking which days had events using a themed icon on a calendar grid — like satellite or star glyphs per day
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For precise value comparison use RoboCalendarBarChart or the color intensity of RoboCalendarHeatmap
componentMeta.a11y: Renders to a canvas with role img and an aria-label prop that falls back to the title; pair with a data table for screen reader users
componentMeta.animation: animateEntrance: boolean — fade-in entrance via RoboFadeIn (preset: standard)

componentMeta.description: Calendar grid where each day carries a scatter point scaled by value
componentMeta.whenToUse: For plotting a daily count as a sized dot on a calendar grid — like satellites reporting position per day
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For color intensity use RoboCalendarHeatmap; for bar height comparison use RoboCalendarBarChart
componentMeta.a11y: Renders to a canvas with role img and an aria-label prop that falls back to the title; pair with a data table for screen reader users
componentMeta.animation: animateEntrance: boolean — fade-in entrance via RoboFadeIn (preset: standard)

componentMeta.description: Circular diagram of weighted relationships between entities drawn as ribbons
componentMeta.whenToUse: For showing pairwise relationships or shared connections among a fixed set of entities — like constellation types sharing launch sites
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For directed multi-stage flow use a Sankey-style layout; for hierarchy use RoboTreemap or RoboSunburstChart
componentMeta.a11y: Renders to a canvas with role img and an aria-label prop that falls back to the title; pair with a data table for screen reader users
componentMeta.animation: animateEntrance: boolean — fade-in entrance via RoboFadeIn (preset: standard)

componentMeta.description: Nested circles sizing entities by value within grouping bubbles
componentMeta.whenToUse: For showing relative sizes of items grouped into categories as packed bubbles — like satellites by mass
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For strict rectangular hierarchy use RoboTreemap; for radial hierarchy use RoboSunburstChart
componentMeta.a11y: Renders to a canvas with role img and an aria-label prop that falls back to the title; pair with a data table for screen reader users
componentMeta.animation: animateEntrance: boolean — fade-in entrance via RoboFadeIn (preset: standard)

componentMeta.description: Square matrix heatmap of pairwise correlation coefficients between variables
componentMeta.whenToUse: For showing how strongly numeric variables move together as a color-coded correlation matrix
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For counts across two categorical axes use RoboHeatmap; for calendar-time density use RoboCalendarHeatmap
componentMeta.a11y: Renders to a canvas with role img and an aria-label prop that falls back to the title; pair with a data table for screen reader users
componentMeta.animation: animateEntrance: boolean — fade-in entrance via RoboFadeIn (preset: standard)

componentMeta.description: Stacked funnel showing a quantity shrinking across sequential stages
componentMeta.whenToUse: For showing how a quantity narrows through ordered stages — like reports moving through a processing pipeline
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For unordered category comparison use RoboBarChart; for part-of-whole at one moment use RoboPieChart
componentMeta.a11y: Renders to a canvas with role img and an aria-label prop that falls back to the title; pair with a data table for screen reader users
componentMeta.animation: animateEntrance: boolean — fade-in entrance via RoboFadeIn (preset: standard)

componentMeta.description: Radial gauge showing a single value against a range with threshold bands
componentMeta.whenToUse: For showing one value against a scale or target — like constellation readiness percent or a compliance score
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For comparing many values use RoboBarChart; for a bare number with a delta use RoboStatCard
componentMeta.a11y: Renders to a canvas with role img and an aria-label prop that falls back to the gauge name; expose the value in adjacent text
componentMeta.animation: animateEntrance: boolean — fade-in entrance via RoboFadeIn (preset: standard)

componentMeta.description: Grid heatmap coloring cells by value across two categorical or spatial axes
componentMeta.whenToUse: For showing value intensity across two axes — like ground-station passes by sector and hour
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For correlation coefficients use RoboCorrelationHeatmap; for daily calendar density use RoboCalendarHeatmap
componentMeta.a11y: Renders to a canvas with role img and an aria-label derived from the title prop; pair with a data table for screen reader users
componentMeta.animation: animateEntrance: boolean — fade-in entrance via RoboFadeIn (preset: standard)

componentMeta.description: Grid of tiny sparkline trends, one mini chart per metric or entity
componentMeta.whenToUse: For showing many small trend lines side by side as small multiples — like a trend per constellation metric
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For one detailed trend use RoboLineChart; for exact values use RoboDataTable
componentMeta.a11y: Renders to a canvas with role img and an aria-label prop that falls back to the title; pair with a data table for screen reader users
componentMeta.animation: animateEntrance: boolean — fade-in entrance via RoboFadeIn (preset: standard)

componentMeta.description: Polar rose chart where category sectors extend outward by value as radial bars
componentMeta.whenToUse: For comparing category magnitudes arranged radially — like incident distribution by watch group
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For accurate magnitude reading use RoboBarChart; for simple part-of-whole use RoboPieChart
componentMeta.a11y: Renders to a canvas with role img and an aria-label prop that falls back to the title; pair with a data table for screen reader users
componentMeta.animation: animateEntrance: boolean — fade-in entrance via RoboFadeIn (preset: standard)

componentMeta.description: Multiple parallel axes with lines linking each records value across dimensions
componentMeta.whenToUse: For comparing records across several numeric dimensions at once — like spacecraft characteristics by type
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: For two variables use RoboScatterChart; for a single ranking use RoboBarChart
componentMeta.a11y: Renders to a canvas with role img and an aria-label prop that falls back to the title; pair with a data table for screen reader users

componentMeta.description: Multi-column value-flow Sankey diagram — e.g. category -> stage -> outcome

componentMeta.description: Context provider that injects the host app router (Link component + usePathname) into Robo navigation components
componentMeta.whenToUse: Once at app root so RoboSidebar, RoboTopbar, and RoboBreadcrumbs render framework-native links (Next.js, TanStack Router)
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: Apps without client routing - the default adapter renders plain anchor tags, so omitting the provider is fine
componentMeta.a11y: Preserves aria-current wiring on active links regardless of the underlying router implementation

componentMeta.description: Staggers the entrance of its direct children with configurable delay and slide offset
componentMeta.whenToUse: Animating lists, grids, or card collections in one item at a time for hierarchy and polish
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: Single elements - use RoboFadeIn or RoboSlideIn; large virtualized lists where offscreen items should not animate
componentMeta.a11y: Honors prefers-reduced-motion - children render in place without motion for users who opt out

componentMeta.description: Per-word or per-character text entrance animation (fade, slide-up, or blur)
componentMeta.whenToUse: Hero headings and empty-state titles where a short piece of text should enter with emphasis
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: Body copy or long paragraphs - per-unit animation of long text is distracting and slow
componentMeta.a11y: Honors prefers-reduced-motion - text renders statically for users who opt out; splits do not break screen-reader reading order

componentMeta.description: Animated content switcher that transitions between keyed panels (horizontal, vertical, or fade)
componentMeta.whenToUse: Swapping between views in place - wizard steps, tab-like content changes, rotating dashboard widgets
componentMeta.whenNotToUse: Accessible tab semantics - use RoboTabs (which supports animateContent); route-level transitions belong to the app router
componentMeta.a11y: Honors prefers-reduced-motion; manage focus yourself when the active panel changes in response to user input

patternMeta.demonstrates: A gallery of the button and action-button family in one place: standard buttons plus copy, export, print, and icon-only action buttons against sample export data.
patternMeta.whenToUse: Use as the reference when a feature needs a toolbar or action row combining several of these specialized buttons, or to see them all side by side before picking which to use.
patternMeta.agentPriority: Prioritize this pattern for reference on button variety and placement conventions. It is not a page-level pattern, so do not use it as an archetype substitute; pair it with a list or dashboard pattern such as Constellation Manifest that needs an action toolbar.

patternMeta.demonstrates: A connected table-to-form mini-flow: select a row, edit it in a validated form, save the change back to the table — not just an isolated table or form demo.
patternMeta.whenToUse: Use as the reference when a feature needs a click-a-row-edit-it-see-the-table-update flow — e.g. constellation management, roster editing, inline record correction. Not for read-only browsing (use List + Search or Filter + Table + Detail instead) or multi-step wizards.
patternMeta.agentPriority: Prioritize this pattern over composing RoboDataTable + RoboForm from scratch whenever the feature request describes editing a record selected from a list, rather than a standalone create form (use Form + Validation archetype for that) or a read-only detail pane (use Filter + Table + Detail archetype for that).

patternMeta.demonstrates: A sortable, filterable, searchable data table with an export action — the standard registry/list page.
patternMeta.whenToUse: Use as the reference for any full-page registry or inventory list where users search, filter by 1-3 dimensions, and optionally export results.
patternMeta.agentPriority: Prioritize this pattern over composing RoboDataTable from scratch whenever the feature request is a browsable list with search/filter, not a browse-then-inspect flow (use Filter + Table + Detail for that) or an edit flow (use Flows/Constellation Editor for that).

patternMeta.demonstrates: A dense single-entity view combining a property grid, event timeline, relationship list, and risk indicators into one condensed panel.
patternMeta.whenToUse: Use as the reference for any everything-about-one-entity view: an intelligence entity profile, a satellite detail panel, or a personnel dossier.
patternMeta.agentPriority: Prioritize this pattern whenever the feature is a single-entity deep dive. For a multi-entity correlation workspace that uses this same dossier component as one panel among several, use OSINT Correlation instead.

patternMeta.demonstrates: The Filter + Table archetype: a searchable, filterable list of records with a toolbar above the table and no side detail pane.
patternMeta.whenToUse: Use as the reference for a filtered report or log-style list where clicking a row would navigate to a separate page rather than opening an inline detail pane.
patternMeta.agentPriority: This is the canonical storyPath for the filter-table archetype in src/agent/archetypes.ts, and the middle case of three closely related Tables patterns. Prefer Constellation Manifest (list-search archetype) when the feature also needs an export action and reads as a registry or inventory; prefer this pattern when the feature is a filtered report or log with no export emphasis and no detail pane; prefer Satellite Search (filter-table-detail archetype) as soon as the feature needs a side panel showing full details for a selected row.

patternMeta.demonstrates: A gallery of the core form control family together: text inputs, checkboxes, radios, selects, sliders, switches, and textareas.
patternMeta.whenToUse: Use as the reference to see every basic form control rendered together before composing a form, or to check visual and spacing consistency across control types.
patternMeta.agentPriority: Prioritize this pattern for control-level reference only. For a full validated form page, use Incident Report (Form + Validation archetype) instead, and for a table-driven edit form, use Flows/Constellation Editor.

patternMeta.demonstrates: A realistic-feeling multi-field form: react-hook-form plus Zod validation, inline field errors, notification toggles, and a post-submit success state.
patternMeta.whenToUse: Use as the reference for any create/submit form with more than 3-4 fields that needs real validation feedback, not just a bare input list.
patternMeta.agentPriority: Prioritize this pattern over hand-rolling form JSX whenever the feature request is a standalone create/submit form. For editing a record selected from a list instead, prefer the Flows/Constellation Editor pattern.

patternMeta.demonstrates: An interactive layer-toggle configurator: switches that turn individual map layers and panels on and off, with a live mock preview of each.
patternMeta.whenToUse: Use as the reference when a feature needs to let a user compose or configure which map layers and panels are active, rather than a fixed map layout.
patternMeta.agentPriority: Prioritize this pattern specifically for layer-configuration UI. For the maps themselves once layers are chosen, use one of the Maps-category patterns such as Constellation Monitor, Multi-Domain Operations, or Emergency Response as the live-map reference instead.

patternMeta.demonstrates: A two hundred-row mission history table with nested, expandable mission legs, using standard date and status cell renderers.
patternMeta.whenToUse: Use as the reference for a general-purpose nested master-detail table at larger row counts, when the feature does not need to match the a reference console schema exactly.
patternMeta.agentPriority: Prioritize this pattern over DCS Routes Table when the feature needs a general nested-table pattern at scale rather than a faithful reproduction of the a reference console routes schema.

patternMeta.demonstrates: The Dashboard Grid archetype: a read-only KPI summary row, line and bar trend charts, and a compact recent-activity table, all on one full page.
patternMeta.whenToUse: Use as the reference for any full-page operations dashboard where the page itself is the dashboard, not a widget dropped into another page, and no user interaction beyond reading is required.
patternMeta.agentPriority: This is the canonical storyPath for the dashboard-grid archetype in src/agent/archetypes.ts. Prioritize it whenever the feature request matches that archetype (full-page KPI-plus-charts dashboard). For a compact dashboard panel embedded inside another page or modal, use the data-dashboard archetype/template instead, not this pattern.

patternMeta.demonstrates: A hundred-row audit log with inline editing of review status on each row and a bulk-approve action across selected rows.
patternMeta.whenToUse: Use as the reference whenever a feature needs a review queue where rows can be approved individually or in bulk, with status changed inline in the table.
patternMeta.agentPriority: Prioritize this pattern over Flight Plan Reports whenever the feature needs inline row editing or bulk actions, not just filtering and browsing.

patternMeta.demonstrates: A fifty-satellite constellation manager table exercising the full RoboDataTable feature set together, including progress cells, boolean cells, and action cells.
patternMeta.whenToUse: Use as the reference to see the complete range of RoboDataTable cell types combined in one realistic table, when deciding which cell renderers a new table needs.
patternMeta.agentPriority: Prioritize this pattern as the cell-type reference for RoboDataTable rather than as a page-level archetype. For the page-level list pattern itself, use Constellation Manifest.

patternMeta.demonstrates: The Filter + Table + Detail archetype: a 3-column browse-then-inspect layout where a left filter panel drives a table in the center and a row click opens full details in a right-hand pane.
patternMeta.whenToUse: Use as the reference whenever a feature needs a browse-then-inspect workflow inline on one page, filtering a list and clicking for details, without navigating to a separate detail page.
patternMeta.agentPriority: This is the canonical storyPath for the filter-table-detail archetype in src/agent/archetypes.ts. Prioritize it over Flight Plan Reports as soon as the feature needs a detail pane driven by row selection; prioritize Flight Plan Reports instead when row clicks should navigate away rather than open an inline pane.
